summary: S12: RecruitmentState for the women -- authored milestones advance a named stage, never a timer, and only a stage string plus the current beat ID ever leaves the simulation

coordination.notes: Only additions to godot-rust/src/expedition.rs are one appended ExpeditionState field (recruitment), two appended ExpeditionError variants, and record_recruitment_milestone. strategy/mod.rs, lib.rs and godot_bridge.rs are untouched; B3 owns the bridge and consumes RecruitmentState::projection() only.
